nodes.description: Private owner address; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole access-control gate for delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated by transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of owner-spender allowances; mutated by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Whitelisted trading address; bypasses the ensure() sale restrictions and is set by setTradeAddress.
Mapping marking addresses that are allowed to sell/transfer without restriction in ensure().
Mapping counting how many transfers an address has already performed; incremented in transferFrom.
Minimum transfer amount allowed by condition(); configurable in init().
Maximum transfer amount allowed by condition(); configurable in init().
Maximum number of sales allowed per address as enforced in condition(); configurable in init().
Total token supply, set in the constructor.
Constant token decimals (18) used for scaling amounts in init() and the constructor.
Public token name, set in the constructor.
Public token symbol, set in the constructor.
Constant address of the Uniswap V2 router (0x7a25...488D) whitelisted in ensure() and pre-approved in the constructor.
Public payable transfer; forwards caller (msg.sender) as _from into transferFrom.
Public payable transferFrom; checks allowance, calls ensure(), then updates balances and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal view whitelist check: owner, Uniswap router, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses skip the condition() sale limits.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-allowance safeguards.
Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits on transfers.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address a with attacker-supplied data b.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum; can be re-invoked at any time by the owner.
Owner-only payable batch transfer; multiplies _value by array length and loops over recipients with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter of the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address computation using the init code hash.
Payable constructor: sets metadata, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, full balance for the owner and unlimited UNI allowance.
Untrusted external caller, used for authorization checks, allowance bookkeeping, balances and owner assignment.
Raw a.delegatecall(b) on an attacker-controlled address: the callee executes with this contract's storage and can re-enter or seize ownership.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed without SafeMath in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath in transferFrom.
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; multiplication can overflow.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend, executed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop, executed without SafeMath.
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Sender parameter of transferFrom, compared against msg.sender.
Recipient parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, used in allowance and balance math.
Address checked against the whitelist in ensure.

Amount forwarded to condition() from ensure.
Spender parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Address whose _onSaleNum counter is checked in condition.
Amount compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
Target address of the raw delegatecall in delegate.
Raw calldata bytes passed to the delegatecall in delegate.
Value written into _saleNum by init.
Minimum sale amount (scaled by decimals) written into _minSale by init.
Maximum sale amount (scaled by decimals) written into _maxSale by init.
Array of recipient addresses iterated over in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount used in the batchSend arithmetic.
New whitelisted trade address assigned to tradeAddress.
Factory address hashed into the pair address computation.
First token address, the pair is ordered with tokenA/tokenB.
Second token address used in the pair computation.
Token name assigned to state variable name.
Token symbol assigned to state variable symbol.
Initial supply parameter scaled by 10**decimals into totalSupply.
Loop index over the _tos array in batchSend.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address compared against _from in ensure.
Loop-local recipient address copied from _tos[i] in batchSend.
Lower-ordered token address computed in pairFor.
Higher-ordered token address computed in pairFor.
Computed pair address returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: transfer passes the untrusted msg.sender as the _from argument into transferFrom.
msg.sender drives the allowance check and bookkeeping in transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], controlled by the caller.
ensure() branches on untrusted sender-controlled addresses (_from/_to) to bypass sale restrictions.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner and reconfigures sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before minting balances to arbitrary addresses.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner and sets a whitelist bypass address.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the deployer.
transfer unconditionally forwards execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls the ensure() whitelist gate before updating balances.
ensure() calls condition() when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction of the sender balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction of the spender allowance.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend subtracts the total from the caller balance without SafeMath.
batchSend adds _value to each recipient balance inside the loop without SafeMath.
delegate executes the raw delegatecall to the caller-supplied address.
The arbitrary delegatecall can execute untrusted code under this contract's storage and re-enter its functions.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments the _onSaleNum counter of the sender.
approve overwrites the allowance mapping entry for the caller and spender.
condition() compares the value against _minSale.
condition() compares the value against _maxSale.
condition() and _onSaleNum are bounded by the _saleNum limit.
ensure() grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to is the owner.
ensure() grants a bypass for the owner-controlled tradeAddress.
ensure() grants a bypass for any address flagged in canSale.
ensure() grants a bypass for the hardcoded Uniswap router address UNI.
delegate gates the arbitrary delegatecall on the owner state variable.
init writes the scaled minimum sale amount into _minSale.
init writes the scaled maximum sale amount into _maxSale.
init writes the sale count limit into _saleNum.
batchSend reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for the caller and recipients.
setTradeAddress assigns the new trade address state variable.
The constructor sets owner from msg.sender.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply parameter.
The constructor mints the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
The constructor scales the supply using the decimals constant.
